artifact.summary: Qiskit implementation of the background Szegedy quantum-walk operator W = S(2Π - I) for a classical Markov chain with 2^n nodes (n from 1 to 6), repeated `steps` times. The isometry U|i>|0> = |i>|phi_i> is built from multiplexed RY rotations. The reflection 2Π - I = U(I ⊗ (2|0><0| - I))U†. The paper-specific OQW-to-unitary conversion is not implemented because the abstract does not specify it.
register_layout: qubits 0..n-1: first (node/position) register |i>, qubit 0 least significant bit of i
qubits n..2n-1: second register |j> (Szegedy neighbour register), qubit n least significant bit of j
example: n=1, qubit 0 = node register, qubit 1 = second register
basis state index = i + 2^n * j in Qiskit little-endian ordering

equation_mapping.explanation: OQW Kraus-operator update is a non-unitary channel and the paper's unitary conversion is not specified; it is not implemented.
Szegedy walk for a classical Markov chain with 2^n nodes. 2Π-I is built as U(I ⊗ (2|0><0|-I))U† using multiplexed RY rotations, then the registers are swapped.
Node probability is obtained by the runner measuring or projecting the node register; no measurement is in the circuit.
Time averaging and the asymptotic limit are classical post-processing, not part of the circuit.

specification_changes.change: Scope narrowed to the background Szegedy walk operator for a classical Markov chain; the OQW-to-unitary conversion is not implemented.
specification_changes.reason: The abstract gives no explicit OQW-to-unitary construction, so it cannot be reconstructed.

specification_changes.change: Pi is realized via U with U|i>|0> = |i>|phi_i>. 2Π-I = U(I ⊗ (2|0><0|-I))U†, where 2|0><0|-I is built from X, multi-controlled Z, X plus a global phase pi.
specification_changes.reason: Gives an exact decomposition into standard gates without a dense opaque unitary.

specification_changes.change: Operator order is reflection first, then swap, with the node register as the first (low-index) register. The state |phi_i> is read as |i>|j> with qubits 0..n-1 holding i.
specification_changes.reason: Fixes a concrete register order for W = S(2Π-I).

specification_changes.change: Probabilities and averages are not computed in the circuit.
specification_changes.reason: The task requires a measurement-free operation.

assumptions: Number of nodes is a power of two, 2^n with n from 1 to 6, so the total is at most 12 qubits.
Transition matrix has nonnegative real entries with rows summing to 1 (tolerance 1e-9).
Input state is prepared by the runner.
The example uses a 2-node chain with an asymmetric transition matrix and two walk steps.
unresolved_issues: The paper's OQW-to-unitary construction (Hilbert space, Kraus operators in the walk, coin and reflection) is unspecified and not implemented.
The asymptotic mean probability formula is not derived.
The paper's variant of the Szegedy operator may differ from the standard form used here.

validation.detail: Circuit built and transpiled successfully; no independent correctness reference selected.
